'''Maritimas''' were a type of [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Snake/Legends|snakes]]. They commonly lived in high [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] areas on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Those creatures' [[Limb/Legends|limbless]] bodies were mostly covered with hexagonal scales, with a series of broad lamellar scales on the belly. The top of their heads sported three horns, and Maritimas also possessed a rattler at the end of their tail.<ref name="Manual" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], just before [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescuing]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]] named [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] encountered these creatures while attempting to rescue his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], from the clutches of [[Gyaos Vader]].<ref name="SW87" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maritimas first appeared in the [[1987]] [[Wikipedia:Japan|Japanese]] [[Star Wars (1987 video game)|''Star Wars'']] video game for the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Entertainment System|Famicom]] home console, although the game's [[canon]]icity was ambiguous.<ref name="SW87" /> Their name was revealed in the [[Wikipedia:Japanese language|Japanese language]] manual of the game, in which it was rendered as マリティマ (''Maritima'') in [[Wikipedia:Katakana|katakana]] syllabary.<ref name="Manual" />
